name: Proxy Appointment Condition
definition: Conditions that must be met to appoint a proxy.

RegistrationMethod.name: Registration Method
RegistrationMethod.definition: Indicates how to register a proxy.

AllowedProxyType.name: Allowed Proxy Type
AllowedProxyType.definition: Specifies who can be assigned as a proxy.

NotificationAddress.name: Notification Address
NotificationAddress.definition: Address where the information on the proxy should be sent.

Meeting.name: Meeting
Meeting.definition: Specifies the meeting to which the proxy appointment conditions aplly.
